en: Black‑and‑white night view of a large illuminated Baroque church with a tall tower and ornate façade, photographed from across a river or open space. Streetlights form a line in the foreground, with light streaks from moving vehicles. Additional historic buildings are visible to the left and right, all dramatically lit against a dark sky. The image has scalloped edges typical of vintage postcards. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
